native_schematic_check.method: Custom S-expression parser; each targeted pin resolved from embedded native symbol unit pin coordinates through direct native wires to global labels; compared with merged and XML pin records. Targeted native instances have rotation 0 and no mirror. No KiCad re-export or ERC was run.

limitations: Consistency is not independent manufacturer-pin correctness or analog performance qualification.
Family TLV9002/TLV9052 models represent selected TLV9004/TLV9054 amplifier units; package crosstalk/ground return geometry/ADC switching are not modeled.
Fixture-only 47k source resistances and 20pF FFC/2pF trace/0.5pF ESD capacitances are declared model assumptions, not physical CAD passives.

Static native connection check follows direct wire endpoints to global labels in these generated sheets; no fresh KiCad netlist, ERC, SPICE simulation, layout/plane/copper extraction or hardware test was performed.
